structured.answer: Harel has tons of products. I only saw the קופת גמל להשקעה tab: fees are all about 0.54–0.61%, so they don't matter for the choice, and מניות (24.04% over 3 years) or S&P 500 (13.7%) look best. I'd lean that way, but I never saw my own השתלמות/pension tabs.

findings.what: Way too many options: 6 tabs of 16–19 tracks each plus folds; impossible to see 'everything' quickly, makes me want to do nothing
Most tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so nothing to compare
Page opens on קופת גמל להשקעה, not the products I actually have
Fees only in tiny percents, all nearly the same; no shekel amount
Ring charts with מניות/מט"ח are unclear
Managed-money column at far left easy to miss
